strings.meta.title: pdff — Sanganisa, shandura uye gadzirisa PDF, Word, Excel mahara
strings.meta.description: Chishandiso chepamhepo chemahara chekusanganisa, kushandura, kuderedza saizi, kupatsanura nekuchengetedza mafaera ako ePDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint nemifananidzo. Hapana kunyoresa, mafaera anobva abviswa pakarepo.
strings.meta.keywords: sanganisa pdf, shandura pdf, pdf kuenda kuword, word kuenda kupdf, jpg kuenda kupdf, pdf kuenda kujpg, deredza saizi yePDF, patsanura pdf, excel kuenda kupdf, zvirongwa zvemahara zvePDF
strings.footer.text: Mahara, hapana kunyoresa. Mafaera ako anobviswa pakarepo kana apedza kugadziriswa.

strings.seo.why[0].title: Mahara 100%
strings.seo.why[0].text: Hapana kunyoresa, hapana kadhi rechikwereti, hapana chiratidzo chinowedzerwa kuzvinyorwa zvako.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Hapana kunyoresa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Hapana nhoroondo yekugadzira: vura peji, dira mafaera ako, zvapera.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Mafaera ako anoramba ari ako
strings.seo.why[2].text: Inogadziriswa, wobva yabviswa pakarepo. Hatichengete zvinyorwa zvako kana data rako.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Fomati dzese
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, mifananidzo, EPUB… kubva pakombuta kana foni.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ehe. Chishandiso chega chega ndizemahara, pasina chiratidzo chinoramba chiripo uye hapana chakavanzwa shure kwekunyoresa. Hapana kadhi rechikwereti rinozombokumbirwa.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Aihwa. Hapana kunyoresa, hapana kero yeemail: unoshandisa zvishandiso pakarepo.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Aihwa. Mafaera ako anoshandisirwa basa rawakumbira chete, obva abviswa. Hapana anozverenga uye haatongogovaniswi.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ehe. pdff inoshanda pabrowser yefoni ipi zvayo, piritsi kana kombuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), pasina chinofanira kuiswa.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, mifananidzo (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML nezvimwe.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Unogona kugadzirisa mafaera anosvika {files} panguva imwe chete, uye gwaro rinobuda rinogona kuva nepeji zvinosvika {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Zviri kuvanzika
strings.privacy.description: Maitiro anoita pdff mafaera ako: hapana nhoroondo, hapana gwaro rinochengetwa, hapana ads uye hapana kutengeswa kwedata.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff yakagadzirwa kuitira kuti zvinyorwa zvako zvirambe zviri zvako. Hezvano, nemashoko akareruka, zvinoitika paunenge uchishandisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Mafaera ako
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Inotumirwa yakachengetedzwa neencryption (HTTPS), inogadziriswa otomatiki, yobva yabviswa pakarepo kana mhedzisiro yagadzirira. Mafaera makuru anopfuura nenzvimbo yechinguvana pasi pezita risingazivikanwe uye anoputswa pakarepo kana kugadzirisa kwapera; kuchenesa otomatiki kunobvisa chero chinhu chingasara mukati memaawa 24 zvichanyanya.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Hapana nhoroondo, hapana data remunhu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff haikumbiri kunyoresa, kero yeemail kana kadhi rechikwereti. Zvinyorwa zvako hazvimboverengwi, hazviongororwi, hazvigovaniswi kana kushandisirwa kudzidzisa uchenjeri hwekugadzira (artificial intelligence).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kuyera vashanyi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tinoverenga vashanyi pasina kuzivikanwa uye pasina makuki (Vercel Web Analytics) kuti tizive kuti ndedzipi nhengo dzinobatsira. Hapana ads, hapana kutevera kumawebhusaiti akasiyana.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Makuki (Cookies)
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kuki imwechete, yekuzvidira: inoyeuka mutauro wawasarudza.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kugarisa saiti (Hosting)
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Saiti iyi inochengetwa neVercel pamaseva muParis; shanduro dzeWord, Excel nePowerPoint dzinobata neRender muFrankfurt. Vapangidzi ava vanongobata mafaera panguva yekushandura chete.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Bata nesu
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Mubvunzo kana mhinduro? Bata nesu kubva papeji yeprojekti:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Sanganisa
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Sanganisa mafaera akati wandei (PDF, Word, mifananidzo…) kuita PDF imwechete, nekutevedzana kwaunosarudza.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Sanganisa mafaera ePDF online mahara (Word, mifananidzo, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Sanganisa PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint nemifananidzo kuita PDF imwechete, nekutevedzana kwaunoda. Mahara, hapana kunyoresa, hapana chiratidzo, mafaera anobva abviswa pakarepo.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Isa mapepa ako ese mufaira rimwechete: pdff inotora maPDF pamwe nezvinyorwa zveWord, mapeji eExcel, mharidzo nemifananidzo, yobva yazvibatanidza kuita PDF yakachena ine bookmark imwe pafaira rega rega.

strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Chishandiso chemahara chekushandura: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB nemafomati 40+. Pamhepo, hapana kunyoresa, unhu hwepamusoro.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Chishandiso chimwe chekushandura fomati yese: Word kuenda kuPDF, PDF kuenda kuWord, JPG kuenda kuPDF, PDF kuenda kuJPG, Excel kuenda kuPDF, PowerPoint kuenda kuPDF, PNG kuenda kuJPG, EPUB kuenda kuPDF… Dira mafaera ako uye pdff inongopa chete fomati dzinogoneka.

strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Bura kana kubvisa mapeji kubva kuPDF — mahara
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Chengetedza mapeji aunoda chete kubva kuPDF, kana kubvisa akawandisa. Pamhepo, mahara, hapana kunyoresa, hapana chiratidzo.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Peji risina chinhu, chovha kusingabatsiri, kana zvakadzokororwa? Nyora mapeji ekuchengeta kana kubvisa (somuenzaniso 1-3, 7, 10-end) uwane PDF yakachena mumasekonzi.

strings.tools.organiser.intro: Mapeji akatorwa nesikeni asina kurongeka? Nyora kurongeka kutsva (somuenzaniso 3, 1, 2, 4-end) kana kuchinja gwaro rese: pdff inoita zvakasara.
